extracted.name: Easy Roasted Cabbage
extracted.description: This roasted red cabbage recipe is simply seasoned with olive oil, salt, and black pepper, then roasted in a hot oven until tender and flavorful.
ingredient_lines: 1 head cabbage, sliced into six 1-inch pieces
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Brush each cabbage piece on both sides with olive oil; season with salt and black pepper. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 40 to 55 minutes.
